description.content:
Executable DEV2 Cases & Citizen API checklist. Run folder 0 first to obtain role tokens, then run the role-specific folders. No runtime result is claimed by this file itself; UAT results remain blank until a clean database run is performed.

INTEGRATION NOTES (source-verified, still require runtime confirmation):
1. Runtime DI: backend/src/Cms.Api/Modules/CasesModule.cs delegates to Cms.Infrastructure.Cases.CasesModuleExtensions.AddCasesModule, and ModuleRegistration calls it.
2. Critical close: closing a Critical request requires an approved CloseCase decision through the shared M3 IDecisionGate. DEV2 registers DecisionGateCloseCaseAdapter; if M3's real gate is not registered, the deny fallback causes 403 CLOSE_DECISION_REQUIRED. The negative collection case verifies that restriction.
3. Partner shares are P2 (D2-11) and must not start before CP2; no partner endpoint exists yet, so no request is included.
4. Target-based recommendation reads exist at GET /api/v1/recommendations?targetId=. Recommendation decisions remain Member 3 owned and are not included in this collection.
5. DEV2 outbox writes include entity_id/idempotency_key per docs/UAT_CORE_LOOP.md DEP-05; verify at runtime.
6. Every authenticated request uses a role-specific variable ({{citizenToken}}, {{coordinatorToken}} or {{caseManagerToken}}). Set {{citizenEmail}}, {{coordinatorEmail}}, {{caseManagerEmail}} and {{demoPassword}} for the demo seed, or override the role token variables manually. Do not include 'Bearer ' in token variables.
